fact: The CEMAC payment services regulation was adopted at Yaoundé on 21 December 2018 and two COBAC implementing regulations on 27 April 2019, and COBAC held a dissemination seminar for the sub-region's banks on 22 July 2019.
title: Seminario sobre la difusión del nuevo sistema regulador de servicios de pago en la CEMAC
